name: Skitter
description: The cave's fast body, on legs twice the length of anything else down here. Brightest thing in the roster on purpose — it is the one that arrives first and from the side, and the fastest thing on dark stone must not also be the hardest to see. Almost all of the drawing is leg: the body is two small lumps, so in flat silhouette it reads as a star of lines where every other cave body reads as a mass. It runs the silk rather than wading it. Gameplay radius 7.

elite.description: Marked: the pale goes to bone-white, the band darkens, and the legs thicken with it.

skitter.description: the fastest gait in the game and the longest legs: the body barely moves while eight long links throw it forward, which is what a thing that runs silk looks like from above
